# Cncf Mia Platform Reviewer

Review Mia-Platform using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. Mia-Platform is a Digital Platform Builder: it enables organizations to build and orchestrate their Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) to scale cloud-native development and operations. Mia-Platform also features a Data Fabric solution that can be used to build a Digital Integration Hub. This solution ingests data from different sources, aggregates it in single views, and makes it available in near real-time.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
